in_pashto.name: زیانہ
in_pashto.meaning: زیانہ د ښکلا او زيوراتو معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: زیانہ د پښتو کلتور او اسلامي دودیزو ارزښتونو سره تړلی یو نوم دی. دا نوم د ښکلا، سجاوٹ او نیکۍ مفهوم څرګندوي او د افغانستان او پښتونستان په سیمو کې ورته ارزښت ورکول کیږي.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ziyana is of Arabic origin and carries a beautiful meaning associated with the admiration of nature, particularly flowers. In many Islamic cultures, including Morocco and Egypt, the appreciation and celebration of nature have deep cultural significance. The name Ziyana reflects this fascination and reverence for the natural world.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ziyana alludes to the idea of contemplation and recognition of the divine in the beauty of creation. This name invites us to reflect on the intricacies of nature and the profound wisdom that lies in the smallest of details. In this sense, Ziyana embodies the Islamic concept of Tawhid (Oneness of God), which asserts that the divine presence is omnipresent and manifest in every atom and cell in the universe. Thus, the name Ziyana inspires appreciation for the divine design in the natural world, and the Name of God is whispered as a reminder of this truth.
